mechanism: Prednisone may increase mefloquine levels via CYP3A4 inhibition and reduce mefloquine clearance; concurrent use increases risk of mefloquine neuropsychiatric and cardiac adverse effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if unavoidable, monitor closely for neuropsychiatric symptoms, seizures, cardiac arrhythmias, and consider alternative antimalarial agents or reduce prednisone dose.
